coverage.population: Selected web-platform worker sample in21 LAC countries;1407 respondents,254 excluded,1153 retained.
coverage.included: 4 reported summary statistics; same selected survey, different time denominators
coverage.omitted: All unlisted entities; this extraction is not necessarily exhaustive.
coverage.missingness: 0 null rows; unknown is not zero. No interpolation or imputation.
coverage.sampling: Survey available through selected platforms, not a probability sample of all workers; individual item denominators can vary.

uncertainty: Source precision retained. No confidence interval is invented. Includes programming and design as well as microtasks; AI-labour subset not isolated. No fraction of final AI product value can be calculated.
limitations: Includes programming and design as well as microtasks; AI-labour subset not isolated.
No fraction of final AI product value can be calculated.
Hourly-pay distributions were trimmed at1st/99thpercentiles; no standard errors supplied for these summaries.

transform.description: Transcribe published factual values; preserve source grain and period.
transform.validation: Source-locator inspection and schema validation; independent review pending.

verification.method: Read primary sources and transcribe exact numbers/qualifiers.

scoring.reason: Show source values; no defensible universal 1–100 AI extremity score.

forecast.reason: No validated prediction model supplied. Do not extrapolate animation into a forecast.
